selection: For each of mirrorAssault and asymmetricReverse, iterate seeds994001..994030, starts0..5, colors red then blue. Select first two configs where archived final pair0 action-value-2 outcome=loss and pair3 v1.3 self candidate outcome=win. Do not inspect observations or scores before committing selection JSON. No substitutions.
replay: Replay selected configuration twice with original engine/policies: action-value-2 vs v1.3, then v1.3 vs v1.3. Require archived outcomes, turns and all metrics to match excluding elapsedMs. Preserve every ordinary decision public observation and legal-ranked counterfactual scores for v1.3, economy-capability-1, team-route-2 and action-value-2. Also record actual response/rule decisions via public traces where available, to distinguish earliest response vs ordinary divergence.
diagnosis: First same-public-state disagreement of legal ordinary choices is primary descriptive marker. Record first divergent actual public observation between replay trajectories separately; after divergence, turn comparisons are not identical-state counterfactuals. Key ordinary decisions are fixed: first ordinary choice disagreement, first subsequent own-team morale<=3 or either side cups>=4 decision, and last ordinary decision of each replay. Full ordinary history retained so no cherry-picked omissions.
privacy: Only captureObservation/traceDecision whitelists; no raw Game, hidden opponent cards, or deck order in artifacts. Public states intentionally include observer's own hand. Counterfactual strategy rankings do not drive the replay.
limitations: Four mechanically selected losses are diagnostic examples, not a strength sample or causal estimate. A changed action score/choice is not proof it caused defeat. No source edits, no tuning or rerun selection. New candidate development uses independent seeds.
